title: False victory
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the rocky ocean below the lighthouse cliff, huge waves, reefs and sea spray, the lighthouse standing on the cliff above. Time and weather: stormy overcast day returning, cold slate-blue and grey palette, gusting wind and rain, an eerie emerald glow from the sea.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): an enormous barnacled mechanical crab walker with glowing green conduits, iron claws, hissing hydraulic pistons and seaweed hanging from its armoured shell.
Camera: aerial descent toward the churning water where the walker sank; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: The defeated walker sinks beneath the grey waves in a swirl of bubbles and foam; for a moment the water calms, then deep below, an emerald beacon begins to pulse steadily.
No dialogue.
Sound: bubbling, sinking groan, then a low rhythmic underwater pulse.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (the Leviathan), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: The pulse quickens, sending green ripples through the water.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: bubbling, sinking groan, then a low rhythmic underwater pulse.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
negative_prompt: text, captions, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra limbs, duplicated characters, sudden wardrobe changes, costume swaps, graphic injury, blood, gore, still image, slideshow, freeze frame, live action humans, 2D flat animation, anime, background music
